events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place in 1969, featuring legendary performances from Jimi Hendrix and The Who.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Festival, we're looking back at the performances that defined a generation, including Jimi Hendrix and The Who.

events.title: Anniversary Of Elvis' Death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977, leaving behind a legacy as the King of Rock and Roll.

angles.name: Elvis Legacy
angles.copy: Today we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away 49 years ago, but his music lives on.

events.title: Tupak Shakur Shot
events.blurb: Tupak Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, his music continues to inspire and influence new generations.

angles.name: Tupak Shakur Legacy
angles.copy: Today we remember Tupak Shakur, who was shot 30 years ago, but his music and message continue to live on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind a legacy as one of the greatest guitarists of all time.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Today we remember Jimi Hendrix, who passed away 56 years ago, but his music and innovative style continue to inspire new generations.

events.title: Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks like Come Together and Something.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since the Beatles released Abbey Road, we're looking back at the making of this iconic album and its enduring legacy.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: The Pretenders' iconic lead singer Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today, we're celebrating her incredible career and hits like Brass in Pocket.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 55 years since John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine, we're looking back at the making of this classic record and its enduring message.

events.title: First iPod Released

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 25 years since the first iPod was released, we're looking back at how it changed the music industry and our listening habits.

events.title: James Bond Day

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day, we're shaken not stirred as we look back at the iconic franchise and its most memorable moments.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86, we're looking back at his incredible career and hits like Imagine and Strawberry Fields Forever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Comedy legend John Cleese turns 87 today, we're looking back at his iconic career and roles in Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since the Beatles released their iconic White Album, we're looking back at the making of this groundbreaking record and its enduring legacy.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
